rules.message: Manufacturer, packer or importer identification and address must be declared where applicable.
rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, package declarations; verify against current amendment text.

rules.message: Country of origin must be declared for imported packages where applicable.
rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, package declarations; verify against current amendment text.

rules.message: Common/generic name of the commodity must be declared.
rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, package declarations; verify against current amendment text.

rules.message: Net quantity/number must be declared using an applicable unit or count declaration.
rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011; applicable amendments.

rules.message: Net quantity declaration must be clear and legible.
rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011; applicable amendments.

rules.message: Month and year of manufacture, packing or import must be declared where applicable, subject to specified exemptions.
rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011; applicable amendments.

rules.message: Best-before/use-by declaration must be present for commodities to which the requirement applies.
rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011; applicable amendments.

rules.message: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) must be declared where applicable.
rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011; applicable amendments.

rules.message: MRP declaration must follow the applicable inclusive-tax requirement and prescribed wording/format.
rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011; applicable amendments.

rules.message: Consumer-care contact details must be declared as required by the rules.
rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011; applicable amendments.

rules.message: Applicable mandatory declarations must be displayed in the prescribed manner on the package/principal display panel.
rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011; applicable amendments.

rules.message: Required package declarations must be clear, prominent and legible as prescribed.
rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011; applicable amendments.

rules.message: Unit sale price must be declared where the applicable provisions require it.
rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011; applicable amendments.

rules.message: Dimensions must be declared where the applicable commodity/package provisions require them.
rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011; applicable amendments.

rules.message: For multipacks or packages containing multiple articles, applicable quantity/number declarations must be provided.
rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011; applicable amendments.

rules.message: Web data must not be treated as proof that a declaration is printed on the physical package.
rules.source: Application-level verification policy; not a statutory rule.

rules.message: If package evidence and official web information conflict, flag the item for manual review.
rules.source: Application-level verification policy; not a statutory rule.

rules.message: If a field is found on an official website but not on the package, mark it as needs review rather than package-compliant.
rules.source: Application-level verification policy; not a statutory rule.
